title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 4 — Determination of the Award Tier
content:
**4.1 Tier from the household percent.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the tier is determined from the case's household FPL percent, the household income as a percent of the HHS poverty guideline for the household size (under the poverty guideline basis and the household definition of the tier): the tier whose band floor and band ceiling bracket it, both bounds inclusive.

**4.2 Annual household income.** Annual household income is the gross household income of the last income look-back months times the income annualization factor; when both pay stubs and a tax return are supplied, the later-dated document is used (the income basis selection).

**4.3 Presumptive approval.** A case with a presumptive basis among the presumptive bases is approved at the presumptive tier without an income test; a propensity score qualifies only when the estimated FPL percent is at most the propensity score maximum FPL percent.

**4.4 Medical hardship.** Above 400 percent FPL, medical hardship applies only when the following clause holds — *the clause "the qualifying medical debt incurred in the last debt-window months exceeds the medical debt threshold percent of annual household income", together with its working of the threshold as that percent of annual household income rounded to the cent, is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis* — and, where the liquid asset test applies, liquid assets do not exceed the liquid asset limit.

**4.5 Hardship cap.** *The clause "the hardship cap is the liability cap percent of annual household income, rounded half-up to the cent", together with its working, is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis.*

**4.6 Denials.** A household above 600 percent FPL, or above 400 percent without qualifying medical debt, is denied for the reason "income above limit"; a hardship applicant over the asset limit is denied for the reason "assets above limit".

**4.7 Recomputation.** When documents change the household figures, the FPL percent and the tier are recomputed before the determination.

### Decision table (clauses in force)

| Household position | Outcome under this section |
|---|---|
| Presumptive basis on record (propensity score at most the maximum) | presumptive tier, no income test |
| Household percent inside a band, at or below 400 percent | the tier whose band brackets it |
| Above 600 percent | denied, income above limit |
| Above 400 percent without qualifying medical debt | denied, income above limit |
| Hardship applicant with liquid assets above the limit (asset test applies) | denied, assets above limit |

Hypothetical: a household at exactly 400.0 percent is bracketed by the 301-400 band (inclusive ceiling) and is not a hardship case.

superseded_clauses: qualifying_medical_debt_usd incurred in the last hardship_debt_window_months exceeds hardship_medical_debt_income_pct of annual household income
the hardship cap is hardship_liability_cap_income_pct of annual household income, rounded half-up to the cent
